Mindfulness Worksheet 5c   (Mindfulness Handouts 5–5c)
Nonjudgmentalness Calendar
Due Date:             Name:                                    Week Starting:
Be aware of nonjudgmental thoughts and expressions when they happen. Use the following questions to focus your awareness on the
details of the experience as it is happening. Write it down later.
Did you
practice
observing
judgmental
thoughts?
Did you
count
judgmental
thoughts?
If so, how
many?
If you replaced a
judgmental thought or
assumption, what was
the judgmental thought
or assumption?
What was the
replacement thought
or assumption?
If you replaced
judgmental with
nonjudgmental facial
or other physical
expressions, please
describe.
Describe any change
after practicing.
Example: Yes
21
My boyfriend is such a jerk
because he should have
remembered to pick me up.
He did forget to pick me up! I
wish he had not forgotten to
pick me up.
I half-smiled and unclenched
my fists.

Wednesday:
